snippet.title: Acrylic Palette: Irodori Cafe - Cheers Gameplay Nintendo 3DS
snippet.description:
Acrylic Palette: Irodori Cafe - Cheers Walkthrough

Let's Play - Acrylic Palette: Irodori Cafe - Cheers

ABOUT THIS GAME

A new sensation communication game that links reality and games.

This work is a communication game set in a fictitious cafe. Real-life idols appear as characters in the game, and you can enjoy conversations and stories with them.

Also, by earning points in mini-games, you can also collect gravures and movies that pop out with the stereoscopic function.
